about: Every picture the example apps use, with the prompt that makes it. Save each as examples/images/<id>.webp (or .png/.jpg); until then the screens show a placeholder. scripts/board-config.mjs writes IMAGE-PROMPTS.md from this file.

groups.title: Tazza, the mascot
groups.note: Every pose is the same Tazza: the same cup, eyes, band, arms and saucer, at the same size. Keep the saucer’s base at the same height in every pose, about 90% of the way down, centred, so the poses swap in place on screen. Transparent backgrounds, so Tazza can stand on any screen.
groups.style: A mascot for a language app: Tazza, a small white espresso cup with a rounded body, one curved handle on its right, a thin tomato-red band around the rim, two big glossy black eyes with a white highlight, a tiny smile and soft pink cheeks, two short rounded arms, standing on a cream #FFE7B8 saucer with a thin tomato-red rim. Soft matte 3D vinyl-toy render, gentle studio light from the top left, a very soft contact shadow, rounded shapes everywhere, warm and simple. No text, no letters, no logos.

groups.title: Photographs
groups.note: The same light, board and colours in all four photos, so they read as one kitchen.
groups.style: Editorial food photography for a sourdough baking app: natural window light from the left, warm and soft, deep shadows, a dusting of flour, a dark rye-brown wooden surface, shallow depth of field, a 50 mm lens, subtle film grain, a muted warm palette of cream, crust brown and rye black. No faces, no text, no logos, no brand packaging.

groups.title: Food photographs
groups.note: Straight down, the same yellow surface in every picture, so the foods line up as a set. The screens crop each photo to a circle, so keep the bowl or plate centred.
groups.style: Bright overhead food photography for a meal-planning app: shot straight down on a pale butter-yellow #FFF4D6 surface, soft daylight, short gentle shadows, fresh and colourful, one simple cream ceramic bowl or plate, generous space around it. No hands, no text, no logos.

groups.title: Photograph
groups.note: One picture, for the opening. Tall, so it can fill the phone.
groups.style: Night running photography: a wet track at night, cold stadium light, deep blacks, one volt-yellow #D4FF3F streak of light, motion blur, high contrast, grain. No faces, no logos on shoes or clothes, no text.

groups.title: Illustrations
groups.note: Painted, not photographed: Lull should feel like a picture book at bedtime.
groups.style: Quiet painterly illustration for a sleep app: soft gouache texture, a muted palette of dusk blue #DCE4EC, midnight #121D33 and one warm lamp orange #D9822B, calm and sparse. No people, no text.

groups.title: Plant photographs
groups.note: The same wall, pot and light for every plant, so the shelf looks like one home.
groups.style: Natural plant photography for a plant-care app: one houseplant in a plain terracotta pot against a soft sage-green #DFE6D8 wall, diffused daylight from a window on the left, calm, true colours, the plant centred with space around it. No people, no text, no logos.

groups.title: Avatars
groups.note: Flat, so they sit well at 40 points.
groups.style: Flat illustrated avatar for a budgeting app: simple geometric shapes, friendly, ink-black #111110 outlines, a flat marigold #F2B705 circle behind the head, no shading, no text.

groups.title: App icons
groups.note: Full square with no rounded corners (iOS adds them). Nothing small: an icon is read at 60 points.
groups.style: An iOS app icon, 1024 × 1024, full square with no rounded corners, one bold simple subject centred with generous margin, flat colour background. No text, no letters.

images.label: Tazza waving hello
images.prompt: Tazza standing on its saucer, waving hello with its right arm raised high, eyes wide and happy, a tiny curl of steam above the rim. Full body, centred, transparent background.

images.label: Tazza listening
images.used: the first phrase, the opening’s mic beat
images.prompt: The same Tazza, leaning slightly to its left, one arm cupped beside its body as if listening closely, eyes curious and looking up. Full body, centred, transparent background.

images.label: Tazza cheering
images.prompt: The same Tazza cheering, both arms up, eyes closed in two happy curves, mouth open in a smile, two small curls of steam rising. Full body, centred, transparent background.

images.label: Tazza asleep
images.prompt: The same Tazza asleep, tilted gently to one side on its saucer, eyes closed as two soft lines, arms resting, one slow curl of steam. Full body, centred, transparent background.

images.label: Tazza waving goodbye
images.prompt: The same Tazza waving goodbye with one arm, holding a tiny crema #FFE7B8 suitcase with a brick-red handle in the other, a warm small smile. Full body, centred, transparent background.

images.label: Sourdough crumb, close
images.prompt: Close-up of a sliced sourdough loaf showing an open, glossy crumb with irregular holes and a dark caramelised crust with a sharp ear, the cut face towards the camera, on a floured board.

images.label: Starter rising in its jar
images.used: the first bake, the opening, today
images.prompt: A tall glass jar of bubbly sourdough starter that has doubled, large bubbles pressed against the glass, a red-orange rubber band around the jar where it started, a folded linen cloth beside it. Keep the bubbles and the rubber band in the middle third of the frame, so the picture also works cropped to a wide strip.

images.label: Hands shaping dough
images.prompt: Seen from above: two floured hands shaping a round of dough on a wooden board, only hands and forearms in the frame, sleeves rolled up.

images.label: A boule out of the oven
images.prompt: A freshly baked sourdough boule in an open cast-iron pot, a little steam rising, a deep brown crust with a burst ear, oven gloves out of focus at the edge.

images.label: Pasta with tomatoes
images.prompt: A bowl of spaghetti with cherry tomatoes, basil and shaved parmesan.

images.label: Salmon rice bowl
images.used: foods they keep, the week, today
images.prompt: A rice bowl with seared salmon, avocado slices, cucumber, edamame and sesame seeds.

images.label: Three cheeses
images.prompt: A small round board of three cheeses with red grapes and a few crackers.

images.label: Dark chocolate
images.prompt: A few broken squares of dark chocolate with a handful of raspberries.

images.label: Chickpea curry
images.prompt: A bowl of chickpea and spinach curry with a spoon of yogurt, rice on the side.

images.label: Toast with ricotta
images.prompt: A slice of toasted sourdough with ricotta, honey and a few thyme leaves.

images.label: Yogurt with raspberries
images.prompt: A bowl of thick yogurt with raspberries, granola and a drizzle of honey.

images.label: Running on a wet track at night
images.prompt: A runner’s legs and shoes mid-stride on a wet running track at night, the lane lines glowing, the stadium lights streaked by motion blur behind. Keep the lower 40% of the frame mostly empty dark wet track: the app sets its own words there, so add none.

images.label: A window at night, rain
images.prompt: A window at night seen from inside a dark bedroom, rain drops on the glass, the lights of a town blurred outside, a small warm lamp on the sill at the lower left, the lower middle quiet and dark, the main subject in the centre square.

images.label: Rain on a tin roof
images.prompt: Rain falling on a tin roof at night, seen close, soft and grey-blue.

images.label: A night train
images.prompt: A night train crossing a dark valley, its windows warm and lit.

images.label: The sea at night
images.prompt: A calm sea at night under a low moon, small soft waves.

images.label: Monstera
images.used: the camera, the first plant, the shelf, coming back
images.prompt: A healthy Monstera deliciosa with large split leaves. Centred, with generous space on every side: it fills a camera viewfinder that shows only the middle of the picture.

images.label: Golden pothos
images.prompt: A golden pothos with leaves trailing over the edge of the pot.

images.label: Fiddle-leaf fig
images.prompt: A fiddle-leaf fig about a metre tall.

images.label: Snake plant
images.prompt: A snake plant with tall upright striped leaves.

images.label: Mia
images.used: who’s in (64 pt), what comes in (38 pt), the goodbye (92 pt)
images.prompt: Portrait avatar of a woman in her early thirties with short dark curly hair and round glasses, shoulders up, smiling.

images.label: Sam
images.used: who’s in (64 pt), what comes in (38 pt), the goodbye (92 pt)
images.prompt: Portrait avatar of a man in his early thirties with a short beard and a striped shirt, shoulders up, smiling.

images.label: Loaf’s icon
images.prompt: A simple stylised sourdough boule seen from the side, cream-coloured with one curved score, on a flat deep crust-brown #BF4F1A background, minimal flat illustration with a soft inner shadow.

images.label: Stride’s icon
images.prompt: One bold volt-yellow #D4FF3F stroke leaning forward like a lane line in motion, on a flat asphalt-black #0E0F0C background.

images.label: Ripe’s icon
images.prompt: A single glossy raspberry, softly stylised, on a flat butter-yellow #FFF4D6 background, soft 3D render.

images.label: Halves’ icon
images.prompt: A circle split down the middle into an ink-black #111110 half and a marigold #F2B705 half, on an off-white #F3F3EE background, flat.

images.label: Lull’s icon
images.prompt: A thin crescent moon that glows like a lamp, soft orange #D9822B, on a deep midnight-blue #121D33 background, a gentle gouache texture.

images.label: Parla’s icon
images.prompt: Tazza’s face close up (a white espresso cup with big glossy black eyes and a tiny smile) on a flat tomato-red #E4472E background, soft 3D render.

images.label: Fern’s icon
images.prompt: A single unfurling fern frond in deep green #16221A rising from a small terracotta #B4572F pot, on a flat sage #DFE6D8 background, minimal flat illustration.
